report.summary: The only failure is test_added_book_is_listed, and the cause is in the app, not the test: list_books in app/main.py serves a cached book list with 70% probability and insert_book never invalidates that cache, so the redirect after adding a book often renders the stale 'No books yet.' page. Classify it as flaky and fix the app first by invalidating _recent_lists on every book write (or removing the random cache bypass), then re-run the test many times to confirm.

causes.title: Book list cache is randomly stale and not invalidated on writes
causes.explanation: app/main.py keeps a per-user cache of the book list (_recent_lists). list_books() returns the cached list whenever the user has a cache entry and random.random() < 0.7, so roughly 70% of page loads ignore the database. insert_book() and the delete handler never clear or update that cache. The test opens /books first, which caches the user's empty list. After add, the POST redirects to GET /books, which most often returns that cached empty list, so the new row never appears. Playwright's expect only re-polls the DOM and never reloads the page, so the 5s wait cannot recover. The outcome depends on chance, so the same code can pass on a rerun (about 30% of the time). Because the randomness is in the app, this is categorised as flaky rather than a test bug. The stale read is still a real defect in the app, though.
evidence: app/main.py:148-157: `_recent_lists: dict[int, list[dict]] = {}` and `if user_id in _recent_lists and random.random() < 0.7: return _recent_lists[user_id]`
app/main.py:160-167: insert_book() performs the INSERT without touching _recent_lists
app/main.py:343-350: books_delete() also writes to the books table without invalidating the cache
app/main.py:321-340: books_add() redirects to /books (303) after insert_book, so the next GET goes through list_books()
Failure aria snapshot shows: paragraph: No books yet. (the empty-state branch of templates/books.html:29-30), even though the row was just inserted
Failure message: Expect "to_contain_text" get_by_test_id("book-row").filter(has_text="Dune-640ffbd6") ... waiting for ... element(s) not found
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:13-15: test adds the book via the UI, then asserts the row text without reloading
tests/support/pages.py:37-38: row() filters book-row by title, so it is empty while the stale page is shown
causes.suggested_fix: In app/main.py, remove the random cache bypass and invalidate the cache on every write: call `_recent_lists.pop(user_id, None)` in insert_book(), in the delete handler, and in api_update_book(). Better still, drop the cache entirely, since the database is the source of truth. Then re-run tests/ui/test_books_ui.py::test_added_book_is_listed many times (for example with --count or a loop) to confirm it passes every time. Do not change the test to hide the failure.
